english.title: Fish for / take salmon waters in Tweed district other than inland waters except by rod, line, net, coble etc
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) fished for or took salmon in waters in the Tweed district other than inland waters, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), except by rod and line, net and coble, bag net, fly net or other stake net
english.legislation: Contrary to article 22(2) and (5) of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
